metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 1984 · Amadeus
metas.description: The life and work of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart seen through the eyes of his contemporary and rival, Antonio Salieri.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 1980 · The Elephant Man
metas.description: A Victorian surgeon rescues a heavily-disfigured and mistreated young man working as a sideshow freak, who gradually reveals his capacity for kindness, intelligence and sophistication.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1980 · Raging Bull
metas.description: The life of boxer Jake LaMotta, whose violence and temper that led him to the top in the ring destroyed his life outside of it.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1982 · Gandhi
metas.description: The life of the lawyer who became the famed leader of the Indian revolts against the British rule through his philosophy of nonviolent protest.
